falsifiers.fixture_translation: Any paper-failed identity unexpectedly matching its oracle relation invalidates that case as a reproduction control.
falsifiers.no_new_mechanism: Any current Receipt Gate effect binding relation that disagrees with the sealed oracle triggers SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_GAP_DETECTED.
falsifiers.semantic_inference: The experiment does not earn a claim that Receipt Gate can infer semantically load-bearing fields from arbitrary payloads.

oracle_visibility: The runner receives pair labels and computes identities. The independent verifier owns correctness scoring from oracle.json.
stop_rule: Run the five frozen pairs once. If all pass, add no mechanism and freeze the pack. If one fails, report only the exact gap; any repair belongs in a separately preregistered build.
